text:
Ashley M.: Quick sync — Developer Academy mini-course launch (tutorial + small refapp + OSS blog + 30-min webinar). Target: 2-week runway, soft launch to community, main launch on May 10. Need owners, bench narrative, webinar plan, and inbound lead routing. Ideas: lightweight hands-on lab, 10-min benchmark demo, sign-up funnel. Who can own which piece?

Kai T.: I can take the tutorial + lab. ETA draft in 4 days. Will need example dataset + quickstart container.

Mike L.: I'll own the refapp and benchmark scripts. Can convert existing demo into a 1-repo package. Need perf numbers: latency/cost for hosted vs dedicated — where to pull?

Sophia R.: I'll write the OSS launch post + social copy. Can we get 2 quotes from eng for the post? Also want 3 CTAs: try, star repo, join webinar.

Nina P.: Webinar ops — I'll book 30-min slot, create registration form, and map inbound to HubSpot. Suggest: gated slide deck + optional trial credits.

DevRel Bot: Meeting scheduled: Thu 16:00 UTC — created calendar event and a Google doc: https://docs.google.com/example

Kai T.: For tutorial lab — propose Dockerfile + small sample dataset (~5MB). Use instructions: 
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-academy && cd dev-academy/tutorial && ./run-local.sh
```

Mike L.: Bench plan: 3 scenarios (local small prompt, hosted API: gpt-lite, dedicated quantized). I'll add a CSV with throughput/latency. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-academy/pull/42

Sophia R.: Draft social hooks: 
- "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — try our mini-course" 
- TL;DR blog + 1-min demo gif. 
I can iterate on tone after we get perf numbers.

Ashley M.: Nice. Owners: Kai(tutorial), Mike(refapp/bench), Sophia(blog/social), Nina(webinar/inbound). Deadline: draft assets by end of week (Fri 23:59 PT). Ping me if blocked. :rocket:

Kai T.: noted. I'll post a short checklist in doc tonight.

Mike L.: Will open the bench PR and add perf matrix by tomorrow.

Nina P.: I'll wire HubSpot form and webhook mapping, share list of fields needed. Also propose audience segment: community-dev + trial-users.

Sophia R.: Need two quotes from eng — @Kai T. and @Mike L., can you add 1-2 lines about why the refapp matters?

Kai T.: adding a short blurb to the doc now.

Mike L.: will add a quick line about deterministic cost/latency comparisons.

Ashley M.: sweet. We'll reconvene Thu after dev updates. Thanks y'all — excited to ship this. :tada:
